changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE terminology_codesystem_version ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, code_system VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, source_url TEXT, source_sha VARCHAR(128), pipeline_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, concept_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, is_current BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, ingested_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW() ); CREATE INDEX idx_termver_current ON terminology_codesystem_version (code_system, is_current);
CREATE TABLE terminology_concept ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, code_system VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, display TEXT NOT NULL, match_text TEXT NOT NULL, properties JSONB, version_id BIGINT ); -- Lookup by exact code (resolve a stored value back to its display). CREATE INDEX idx_termconcept_system_code ON terminology_concept (code_system, code); -- Prefix autocomplete on the normalised key (text_pattern_ops makes -- `match_text LIKE 'q%'` an index range scan without a trigram ext). CREATE INDEX idx_termconcept_match ON terminology_concept (code_system, match_text text_pattern_ops);

rollback.sql: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS terminology_concept; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS terminology_codesystem_version;
